title: The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster Game Heads West
content: NIS America announced on Friday that it will release The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster ( Shinigami Hime to Ishokan no Kaibutsu ) game in the West for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam in 2027.
author: ANN

title: Tokyo Anime Awards Festival Ends
content: TAAF launched in 2014 as an independent festival and has had 13 iterations. It was an evolution of the Tokyo Anime Award, which was part of the Tokyo International Anime Fair from 2002-2013. TAAF's X (formerly Twitter ) account and YouTube channel will shut down on September 30.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Biggest Isekai Already Has a Finale Date For Latest Season
content: Over the years, the isekai genre keeps expanding more and more, with at least a few series each quarter. However, even among the endless stream of such popular series, Re:Zero − Starting Life in Another World stands out as one of the best in the industry.
author: ComicBook

title: Additional Cast for 'Romelia Senki' Announced
content: The official website for the Romelia Senki ( Romelia War Chronicle ) television anime announced 14 additional cast on Friday. The anime series adapting Ryou Ariyama 's action fantasy light novel will air for two cours on Tokyo MX, BS11, Sun TV, and KBS Kyoto in October 2026.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Hellbound Artist Kyoo-seok Choi Teams Up With MEEN for New Webtoon Crocodile
content: Kakao Entertainment announced on Friday that Crocodile , a new action noir webtoon created by MEEN and Hellbound artist Kyoo-seok Choi, will launch on Kakao Page on September 5. The series marks the first collaboration between the two creators.
author: ANN

title: 'Tantei wa Mou, Shindeiru. Season 2' Reveals Additional Cast, New Staff, Theme Songs, Third Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Nigojuu 's Tantei wa Mou, Shindeiru. ( The Detective Is Already Dead ) revealed additional cast, new staff, the theme songs and third promotional video for the second season on Friday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 7 at 9.30 p.m.
author: MyAnimeList

title: WEBTOON's Parent Company Naver Invests in Emmy-Winning Animation Studio Baobab Studios
content: Naver Ventures, the U.S.-based venture investment arm of NAVER, the parent company of WEBTOON Entertainment, announced on Wednesday it has made a strategic investment in Baobab Studios ( Namoo, Crow: The Legend, The Witchverse ), the 10-time Emmy-winning transmedia animation studio.
author: ANN

title: Webtoon-Based Animated Film Guardians of the Video Game to Open in October in Korea
content: LOCUS Animation Studio announced on August 20 it will release Guardians of the Video Game , a theatrical animated film based on Gasfard's webtoon of the same name, in theaters across South Korea in October. The film follows Patch, an ace agent responsible for setting up worlds inside video games.
author: ANN

title: The Elusive Samurai Anime's 2nd Season Casts Niina Hanamiya
content: The staff for the second television anime season based on Yūsei Matsui 's The Elusive Samurai ( Nigejōzu no Wakagimi ) manga revealed on Friday that Niina Hanamiya is joining the cast as Mima. The new season began airing on July 17 at 11:30 p.m.
author: ANN
